newsitem.title: USA: Envirodyne to review business options.
newsitem.headline: Envirodyne to review business options.

text.p: Envirodyne Industries Inc said Friday it planned to hire an investment adviser to assist its directors in evaluating the company's strategic alternatives.
The options may include sale of the entire company, sale of business units or recapitalization.
On August 11, the company received an acquisition proposal from Heico Holdings Inc, which is affiliated with Michael Heisley, an Envirodyne director.

Under the offer, holders of Envirodyne common stock, other than Heico and its affiliates, would receive $8.50 a share in cash plus possible additional cash payments based on the amount of any proceeds received from a pending patent-infringement lawsuit.

On August 13, Zapata Corp, holder of 40 percent of the company's common stock, said that if the company engaged an independent financial adviser to maximize stockholder value, Zapata would support the process and would make an offer to purchase Envirodyne.
Envirodyne said it would study Heico's offer and any Zapata offer as part of a formal evaluation process.
Shares of Envirodyne, which makes food packaging, were 1/4 higher at 8-1/4 on Friday afternoon.
